description_en: Modifies the O&M task configuration of a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 修改mongoDb实例的运维任务配置
name: ModifyActiveOperationMaintenanceConfig

parameters.help_en:
The cycle type. Valid values:
Month: Monthly.
Week: Weekly
parameters.help_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周
parameters.name: cycle_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of days in the O&M cycle, separated by commas (,).

If CycleType is set to Month, each item is an integer from 1 to 28, which represents a day of the month.
If CycleType is set to Week, each item is an integer from 1 to 7, which represents a day of the week
parameters.help_zh:
运维周期日期列表，使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

当 CycleType 为 Month 时，每项为 1～28 的整数，表示每月的日期。
当 CycleType 为 Week 时，每项为 1～7 的整数，表示每周星期几
parameters.name: cycle_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the instance O&M window. The time is in the HH:mmZ format and in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 实例运维开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ，UTC时间
parameters.name: maintain_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the instance O&M window. The time is in the HH:mmZ format and in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 实例运维结束时间，格式为HH:mmZ，UTC时间
parameters.name: maintain_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the configuration takes effect. Valid values: 
1: Effective. 
2: Invalid
parameters.help_zh:
是否生效 
1 生效 
2 无效
parameters.name: status
